title: 2026-11-17 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：Zero-SM NCCL: A Systematic Guide to Designing and Deploying SM-Free GPU Communication (NVIDIA, ETH Zurich, 通信不占 SM，重叠才真正免费。)、Fuse-All MoE Inference Kernel with Load Balancing on TPUs (Meta SuperIntelligence Lab, MoE 在 TPU 上的瓶颈是搬运与偏斜，融合 kernel 加在线再均衡可吃掉大半。)、VelServe: Taming Decode Jitters in LLM Inference with Tail-Calibrated Scheduling (Sprinklr, Microsoft, 解码抖动要靠尾部预算治，不是靠均值调度。)、Callo: Serving Cache-Miss Requests with Speculative Decoding on Invalidated KV under Prefill-Decode Disaggregation (Duke University, 作废的 KV 别急着扔，可以当投机草稿用。)

highlights.name: Zero-SM NCCL
highlights.note: 通信完全不占 SM，AllGather 带宽 +1.36x

highlights.name: Fuse-All MoE
highlights.note: TPU 上 MoE 融合 kernel + 在线均衡，吞吐 +34.5%

highlights.name: VelServe
highlights.note: 按尾部时延反解每步 prefill 预算，goodput 2.4-2.9x
